description: This file defines the CodeBlockHandler class, which implements the EditHandler interface to manage the handling and styling of code block spans in a markdown editor context within an Android application. It initializes theme settings, configures span persistence, and processes markdown spans by applying appropriate span styles.

classes.name: CodeBlockHandler
classes.description: A handler for managing markdown code block spans in an editor, including initialization, configuration of persisted spans, and span handling logic.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the handler with a Markwon instance and extracts the theme configuration.

methods.name: configurePersistedSpans
methods.description: Configures which spans should be persisted during editing by registering CodeBlockSpan.

methods.name: handleMarkdownSpan
methods.description: Handles the application of the markdown span in the editable text, applying styling based on delimiters detected.

methods.name: markdownSpanType
methods.description: Returns the class type of the markdown span being handled, namely CodeBlockSpan.
